issues.title: R3 Network Timeout Ambiguity
issues.why: R3 mandates a 60s timeout and 3x exponential backoff for LLM calls but doesn't provide a normative code snippet like R1 and R2, increasing implementation variance for new auditors.
issues.fix: Add a normative Python/Node code snippet for R3 in §00 demonstrating the specific backoff and jitter logic.

issues.title: Dangling Reference to check-ac-family-index.py
issues.why: AC-T-31 references a future validator 'check-ac-family-index.py' which is not yet in the inventory or provided in the context.
issues.fix: Mark the script as 'TBD/Future' in the AC-T-31 text or add it to the reserved slot range in the inventory.

issues.title: Exit Code 2 vs 130 Conflict
issues.why: R4 mandates exit 130 for signal interrupts, while R5 and others mandate exit 2 for environmental errors; a mediocre coder might confuse 'invocation error' with 'process interrupt'.
issues.fix: Explicitly state in the Exit Codes table that 130 is the reserved override for SIGINT/SIGTERM per R4.
